purpose: Owner decisions bound to specific model revisions. An approval is valid only for the exact source/export/material revisions listed here; any meaningful visual revision invalidates it until the owner reviews the change again.

decision_log.scope_statement: Approved the shown Blender geometry and material direction for exactly three bindings: rebel_battleship, rebel_frigate and the Alliance-owned (rebel) shipyard. Approval does not extend to any other model, faction or catalogue entry.
not_approved_by_this_decision: any other ship, station, satellite, construction, planet or campaign asset
Syndicate, Imperial or Confederacy catalogue entries
a generic asset registry or mod interface (S02/S04)
a production default switch, merge, tag or release (S11)
decision_log.how_recorded: Recorded from the owner's approval of the battleship geometry/material captures and then of the frigate/shipyard comparisons in the model-migration conversation. The durable evidence is this manifest plus the receipts referenced below; no timestamp is fabricated beyond the recorded conversation date.

decision_log.scope_statement: Confirmed that the trio on main still looks like what was approved, which is the owner-side half of the S03 check: an engineering-only change must not move appearance. The owner's words were "That looks good", said after being shown the approved trio-in-game capture beside a fresh capture of today's main.
decision_log.confirms: approved-trio-2026-10-16 (unchanged; this decision approves no new revision)
not_approved_by_this_decision: any change to the approved trio revision, which stays the one recorded by approved-trio-2026-10-16
the S03 pipeline implementation, which is reviewed as an engineering change
any later art revision of the trio, including hull-detail work

decision_log.scope_statement: Approved the hull surface-detail revision of the Alliance Pelagic battleship - the only asset this revision changes. The owner's words were "This looks good", after reviewing the revision against the approved hull at capital-detail, capital-close and tactical cameras plus native-pixel crops of the bow deck and the aft machinery.

revision.change: hull surface detail: raised deck plating with edge trenches, banded bow-crown armour with strakes and machinery wells, flank armour belt with dark gaps, machinery banks, vent banks, bridge-base window bands, drive housings, ram ribs, owner-colour prow chevron and deck centre stripe
revision.silhouette_change: none - detail is 0.5 to 4 world units proud of the surfaces it sits on, the mesh Z extent is unchanged (-143.5 to 135.0) so the in-game length is unchanged, and no collision or simulation field moves

not_approved_by_this_decision: the frigate and the shipyard, which this revision does not touch
any other ship, station, satellite, construction, planet or campaign asset
raising any triangle or file budget, including for the frigate and shipyard rollout
a production default switch, registry activation, tag or release

catalogue_size_policy.note: Renderer-only size policy scales the authored hull to the pre-existing catalogue length; the hull-detail revision keeps the mesh Z extent identical, so this length is unchanged. Collision radii and simulation fields are unchanged.

named_features.note: Four individually removed-and-measured broad-face worklights. Evidence: artifacts/alliance_blender_trio/worklight-pixels.json and pixel-checks/.

integration_state.detail: The renderer currently selects the authored trio by hardcoded identity checks (shape key 'rebel:battleship' / 'rebel:frigate' in render/faction_ships.py, and faction=='rebel' and data_id=='shipyard' in render/faction_stations.py). There is no persisted preview/default switch.
integration_state.required_before_broader_rollout: S04 (plus the S02 contract) must replace this with an explicit, persisted, reversible opt-in preview selection before any production art merge or wider catalogue rollout.
integration_state.production_default: hardcoded-preview-for-three-bindings; every other catalogue entry still resolves to the legacy procedural mesh
integration_state.note: All three authored assets are in main's tree and render through the hardcoded identity checks described above; what does not exist yet is a registry or resolver selection (S04) for them.
